title: 被动语态：be + done 与各时态
objective: 今天只学一个点：被动语态的构成与各时态形式。主动句讲「谁做了什么」，被动句把受事（被做的东西）提上主语位，公式是 `受事主语 + be + 过去分词（done）`。be 是时态的挂点：一般现在 `is / are + done`、一般过去 `was / were + done`、一般将来 `will be + done`、现在完成 `has / have been + done`——主动句怎么变时态，be 就怎么变，done 永远不变，所以任意时态的主动句都能改成被动句。谓语 = 动词 + TAM（时 / 态 / 气）的整体，被动句里这个整体就是「be（随时态变形）+ done」。施动者（by 短语）不知道或不重要就省，只有强调「谁做的」才留。U06L44 预告过 be + done 的最小定义，今天正式立定义。
goal: 能把任意时态的主动句改成被动句。

sentences.en: A strange rumor is going around in the forest these days.
sentences.zh: 森林里这些天流传着一个奇怪的传言。
sentences.note: 被动基本形对照：a rumor 是「被讲」的，但「流传」英语顺说 go around，不写被动 is told；被动基本形 = be + 过去分词，谁讲的不重要

sentences.en: The rumor says the wolf broke the window of Carrot Home last winter.
sentences.zh: 传言说，去年冬天狼打碎了 Carrot Home 的窗户。

sentences.en: The fact was reported by two birds this morning.
sentences.zh: 这件事今天早上由两只鸟报告了出来。
sentences.note: by 短语保留：施动者 two birds 值得点名，强调「谁说的」才用 by 引出

sentences.en: The birds confirmed the fact, and now the whole forest knows it.
sentences.zh: 两只鸟证实了这件事，现在整个森林都知道了。

sentences.en: The window was broken last winter.
sentences.zh: 窗户去年冬天被打碎了。
sentences.note: 一般过去被动：was / were + done——过去被做的事，施动者不明就省掉 by

sentences.en: A new wall was built in the garden in spring.
sentences.zh: 春天，园子里砌起了一堵新墙。

sentences.en: A new sign has been put up this week.
sentences.zh: 这周，新招牌已经挂了起来。
sentences.note: 现在完成被动：has / have been + done——到现在已经被做完

sentences.en: Two new tables will be delivered to Carrot Home tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 两张新桌子明天会被送到 Carrot Home。

sentences.en: All the work will be finished before the wolf comes.
sentences.zh: 所有的活儿都会在狼来之前干完。

sentences.en: The wolf was caught near the shop last winter, but the sheep explained everything.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天，狼在小店附近被抓，但绵羊把一切都解释清楚了。

sentences.en: The wrong number in the story was corrected quickly.
sentences.zh: 故事里那个错的数字很快就被纠正了。
sentences.note: by 短语省略：谁纠正的不重要、不言自明——施动者不明或不重要就直接省

sentences.en: The wolf was not angry and smiled instead.
sentences.zh: 狼没有生气，反而笑了。

sentences.en: The wolf will be invited to the big dinner tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天，狼会被邀请来参加大餐。

sentences.en: Everyone in the forest loves the true story.
sentences.zh: 森林里人人都喜欢这个真实的故事。

vocab.example: A strange rumor is going around in the forest these days.
The fact was reported by two birds this morning.
The fact was reported by two birds this morning.
The birds confirmed the fact, and now the whole forest knows it.
A new wall was built in the garden in spring.
A new wall was built in the garden in spring.
Two new tables will be delivered to Carrot Home tomorrow.
The wolf was caught near the shop last winter, but the sheep explained everything.
The wrong number in the story was corrected quickly.
The wrong number in the story was corrected quickly.

notes.rule:
**规则**：被动语态 = `受事主语 + be（随时态变形）+ 过去分词（done）`，焦点是「什么东西怎么样了」，而不是「谁做的」。变被动三步：①主动句的宾语提为主语；②按主动句的时态和新主语的单复数定 be（`is made` / `was made` / `will be made` / `has been made`）；③动词变过去分词（done）。**by 短语（施动者）两留两省**：施动者不知道、不重要、不言自明就省（`The window was broken.`）；只有强调「谁做的」才留（`The fact was reported by two birds.`）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The carrot is made into soup every day. / The carrot was made yesterday. / The carrot has been made.` —— 被动随时态变形：be 变，done 不变
❌ `The window broken last winter. / The window was broke last winter.` —— 被动句不能缺 be；过去分词是 broken 不是 broke
✅ `The fact was reported by two birds. / The window was broken.` —— 施动者值得点名才留 by，否则省

practice.stem: 「The window was broken last winter.」为什么用被动语态？
options: 焦点在「窗户怎么样了」，谁打碎的不明、不重要
broken 是形容词，不能作谓语
practice.explanation: **A**。被动句的焦点是受事「窗户怎么样了」；打碎窗户的人不明、不重要，所以用被动并省掉 by 短语。

practice.stem: 「A new sign has been put up this week.」是哪种形式？
options: 一般过去被动：was / were + done
现在完成被动：has / have been + done
一般将来被动：will be + done
一般现在被动：is / are + done
practice.explanation: **B**。has been + done 是现在完成被动——到现在已经被做完；was / were + done 是一般过去，will be + done 是一般将来。

practice.template: The rabbit eats the carrot every day. → The carrot ______ every day.
practice.explanation: **is eaten**。一般现在被动：受事 the carrot 是单数，be 用 is，eat 的过去分词是 eaten。

practice.template: The wolf broke the window last winter. → The window ______ last winter.
practice.explanation: **was broken**。一般过去被动：be 用 was，break 的过去分词是 broken。

practice.template: The rabbit has made the soup. → The soup ______.
practice.explanation: **has been made**。现在完成被动：have / has been + done，make 的过去分词是 made。

practice.prompt: 用 eat / break / make 各写一个被动句（时态自选），其中 1 句保留 by 短语、其余省略，并说出 by 留或省的理由。
sample: The carrot is eaten every day.
The window was broken by the wolf last winter.
The soup has been made.
practice.criteria: be + done 齐全、时态对即可

quiz.stem: 被动语态的基本构成是什么？
options: 受事主语 + be + 过去分词
quiz.explanation: **B**。被动 = 受事主语 + be + 过去分词：be 随时态变形，done 才是被动的标志。

quiz.stem: 被动句里引出施动者的介词是 ______。
quiz.explanation: **by**。by 短语引出施动者：The fact was reported by two birds；施动者不明或不重要就整个省掉。

quiz.stem: 「Two new tables will be delivered to Carrot Home tomorrow.」是哪种形式？
quiz.explanation: **C**。will be + done 是一般将来被动——明天将要被送来的桌子。

quiz.stem: 「The window was broken.」里 broken 是动词的过去______词。
quiz.explanation: **分**。broken 是 break 的过去分词，和 was 一起构成一般过去被动。

quiz.stem: 「名词 + 分词」的独立主格结构，本质是什么？（复习 U06L51：独立主格：名词 + 分词的状语）
quiz.explanation: **A**。独立主格「名词 + 分词」本质是状语从句的简化（Weather permitting …）（U06L51）。

quiz.stem: want / decide / promise 后接 to do 表「还没做」：The wolf promises ______ (bring) a gift.（复习 U06L45：不定式 to do）
quiz.explanation: **to bring**。「打算做、还没做的事」跟在 promise 后用 to do：promises to bring（U06L45）。

title: 被动的特殊变形与限制
objective: 今天只学一个点：被动的三类特殊变形与两类限制。①双宾被动：`give sb sth` 的两个宾语都能当主语——人提主语（`sb is given sth`），物提主语、间接宾语前补 to（`sth is given to sb`）。②含介词的短语动词被动：`look after` 是整体，`be looked after` 里介词不能丢。③限制：不及物与表状态的动词（happen / belong to / cost）没有宾语可提前，压根没有被动；主语是物的 `sell well / taste good / need doing` 用主动形式表被动。遇到被动变形先问两句：这个动词有宾语吗？它是短语动词吗？
goal: 能处理双宾、短语动词的被动，不写 The accident was happened。

sentences.en: Yesterday the wolf gave the rabbit two wooden tables.
sentences.zh: 昨天，狼给了兔子两张木桌。

sentences.en: The rabbit was given two wooden tables yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天，兔子收到了两张木桌。
sentences.note: 双宾被动 · 人作主语：间接宾语 the rabbit 提为主语，直接宾语 two wooden tables 原样留在后面

sentences.en: Two wooden tables were given to the rabbit yesterday.
sentences.zh: 两张木桌昨天被送给了兔子。
sentences.note: 双宾被动 · 物作主语：物提主语，间接宾语前补 to：were given to the rabbit

sentences.en: The old lamp was returned to the wolf, and the rabbit passed him two warm bowls.
sentences.zh: 旧台灯被还给了狼，兔子又递给他两只温热的碗。

sentences.en: The wolf promised to lend the sheep a big pot for the dinner.
sentences.zh: 狼答应把一口大锅借给小绵羊办晚餐。

sentences.en: Carrot Home is looked after well every day.
sentences.zh: Carrot Home 每天都被照料得很好。
sentences.note: 短语动词被动：look after 是整体——介词 after 不能丢：is looked after

sentences.en: The storm happened last winter.
sentences.zh: 那场暴风雨是去年冬天发生的。
sentences.note: happen 没有被动：不及物动词没有宾语可提前——不能写 was happened

sentences.en: The old lamp belongs to the wolf.
sentences.zh: 旧台灯是狼的。

sentences.en: The carrot soup sells well on cold days.
sentences.zh: 胡萝卜汤在冷天卖得很好。
sentences.note: 主动形式表被动：sells well——主语是物，用主动形式表达「被卖得好」

sentences.en: This morning the wolf admitted the fact at the market.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，狼在市场上承认了这件事。

sentences.en: The honest wolf was praised by everyone in the forest.
sentences.zh: 这只诚实的狼受到了森林里所有人的称赞。

sentences.en: The good news spread quickly through the forest.
sentences.zh: 好消息很快传遍了森林。

sentences.en: That evening the wolf served the whole family hot soup.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，狼给全家人端上了热汤。

vocab.example: The old lamp was returned to the wolf, and the rabbit passed him two warm bowls.
The old lamp was returned to the wolf, and the rabbit passed him two warm bowls.
The wolf promised to lend the sheep a big pot for the dinner.
The wolf promised to lend the sheep a big pot for the dinner.
The old lamp belongs to the wolf.
This morning the wolf admitted the fact at the market.
The honest wolf was praised by everyone in the forest.
That evening the wolf served the whole family hot soup.
The good news spread quickly through the forest.
That evening the wolf served the whole family hot soup.

notes.rule:
**规则**：三类特殊变形 + 两类限制。①**双宾被动**：`give sb sth` 的两个宾语都能当主语——人提主语（`The rabbit was given two tables.`），物提主语、间接宾语前补 to（`Two tables were given to the rabbit.`；give / show / send 用 to，buy / get 用 for）。②**含介词的短语动词被动**：短语动词是整体，介词不能丢——`look after` → `be looked after`。③**没有被动的动词**：不及物动词（happen / arrive）和表状态的短语（belong to / cost）没有宾语可提前，`was happened` ❌。④**主动形式表被动**：主语是物 + `sell well / taste good / need doing`，用主动形式表达被动含义，不要再加 be。另有一处别丢东西：make / see 这类动词的被动要还原 to（`be made to do`，U06L49 已收口）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The rabbit was given two tables. / Two tables were given to the rabbit.` —— 双宾两路变，物作主语别漏 to
❌ `The storm was happened. / The shop was looked well.` —— happen 没有被动；短语动词 look after 的介词不能丢
✅ `The carrot soup sells well. / The bowls need washing.` —— 主动形式表被动，不要再加 be

practice.stem: 「The rabbit was given two wooden tables.」是什么结构？
practice.explanation: **A**。was given 是 give 的双宾被动，间接宾语 the rabbit 提为主语——人作主语，物 two wooden tables 留在后面。

options: The storm was happened last winter.
The old lamp was belonged to the wolf.
The carrot soup sells well on cold days.
The shop was looked well every day.
practice.explanation: **C**。sell well 是主动形式表被动；A 的 happen 没有被动，B 的 belong to 没有被动，D 的短语动词丢了 after（应为 was looked after）。

practice.template: The wolf gave the rabbit a carrot. → The rabbit ______ a carrot by the wolf.
practice.explanation: **was given**。双宾被动 · 人作主语：人提主语，直接宾语 a carrot 留在动词后面。

practice.template: The wolf gave the rabbit a carrot. → A carrot ______ the rabbit by the wolf.
practice.explanation: **was given to**。双宾被动 · 物作主语：物提主语，间接宾语前补 to。

practice.template: The rabbit looks after the shop well. → The shop ______ well by the rabbit.
practice.explanation: **is looked after**。短语动词 look after 是整体，介词 after 不能丢。

practice.prompt: 把「The wolf gave the rabbit a carrot.」按「人作主语」「物作主语」两条路各变一个被动句；再用 happen / sell 各造一句（一个不用被动、一个主动表被动）。
sample: The rabbit was given a carrot by the wolf.
A carrot was given to the rabbit by the wolf.
The storm happened last winter.
The carrot soup sells well.
practice.criteria: 双宾两路、限制用对即可

quiz.stem: 「A carrot was given to the rabbit.」里 to the rabbit 为什么不能丢？
options: give 的物作主语时，间接宾语前要补 to
少了 to 句子就变成主动句
quiz.explanation: **A**。give 的物作主语时，间接宾语前必须补 to：was given to the rabbit。

quiz.stem: 短语动词变被动，介词不能丢：look after → be looked ______。
quiz.explanation: **after**。look after 是一个整体，变被动是 be looked after，介词丢不得。

quiz.stem: 哪句不能改成被动？
options: The wolf gave the rabbit a carrot.
quiz.explanation: **B**。happen 是不及物动词，没有宾语可提前，压根没有被动；其余三句都有宾语可提前。

quiz.stem: 「The carrot soup sells well.」主语是物，用______动形式表被动含义。
quiz.explanation: **主**。主语是物的 sell well 用主动形式表达被动含义，不要再加 be。

quiz.stem: 「The window was broken last winter.」里 was broken 是什么形式？（复习 U07L52：被动语态：be + done 与各时态）
quiz.explanation: **A**。was + done 是一般过去时的被动（U07L52）。

quiz.stem: hear + 宾语 + done 表「被……」：his name is called → The rabbit heard his name ______。（复习 U06L50：感官动词 + 宾语 + do / doing / done）
quiz.explanation: **called**。「hear + 宾语 + done」表示「被……」：his name 是「被叫」的，用过去分词 called（U06L50）。

title: 主谓一致 I：语法一致与意义一致
objective: 今天只学一个点：主谓一致的前两大原则——语法一致与意义一致。谓语 = 动词 + TAM（时 / 态 / 气）的整体，它的单复数跟着主语走。语法一致（默认原则）：主语的语法形式定谓语——复数主语配复数谓语（`The parents are …`），单数、不可数主语配单数谓语（`The soup is …`）。意义一致：family / team / crowd 这类集体名词看「整体还是成员」——整体用单数（`The family is big.`），成员各自行动用复数（`The family are having dinner.`）；people / police 本身就表复数概念，谓语一律用复数。each / every / 不定代词（someone / everyone / nobody …）作主语一律配单数谓语。判谓语先抓主语核心，of 介词短语不算数（U02L09 讲过 family 的复数形式，一致问题今天收口）。
goal: 能判断集体名词、不定代词句的谓语单复数。

sentences.en: The rabbit family is cooking a big dinner for the whole forest.
sentences.zh: 兔子一家正在为整个森林做一顿大餐。

sentences.en: Every member of the family has a job.
sentences.zh: 家里每个成员都有一份活儿。
sentences.note: each / every + 名词一律单数：主语核心 Every member，谓语用 has——of the family 只是修饰

sentences.en: The parents are cooking the soup.
sentences.zh: 父母在煮汤。
sentences.note: 语法一致（默认原则）：主语 The parents 是复数，谓语用 are——主语的单复数形式定谓语

sentences.en: The little team is working hard.
sentences.zh: 小团队干得很卖力。

sentences.en: The family are all working around the big table.
sentences.zh: 一家人都围着大桌子各自忙活。
sentences.note: 意义一致（成员）：强调家人们各自在忙，谓语用复数 are——和「看作整体用单数」对照

sentences.en: The crowd outside the shop is getting bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 店外的人群越来越大。
sentences.note: 意义一致（整体）：The crowd 看作「一群人」这个整体，谓语用单数 is

sentences.en: The police are coming to listen to the true story.
sentences.zh: 警察也来听这个真实的故事。

sentences.en: Someone has told the truth about the wolf at the market.
sentences.zh: 有人在市场上说出了关于狼的真相。
sentences.note: 不定代词单数约定：someone / everyone / nobody 一律配单数谓语——has told

sentences.en: Nobody believes the old rumor now.
sentences.zh: 现在没有人相信那个旧传言了。

sentences.en: Each of the neighbors is bringing a carrot to the dinner.
sentences.zh: 每位邻居都会带一根胡萝卜来赴宴。

sentences.en: Some relatives are coming from the town.
sentences.zh: 几个亲戚从镇上赶来。

sentences.en: The whole family will celebrate together.
sentences.zh: 全家要一起庆祝。

sentences.en: The big dinner will start at seven in the evening.
sentences.zh: 大餐晚上七点开始。

The parents are cooking the soup.

Each of the neighbors is bringing a carrot to the dinner.

The whole family will celebrate together.

notes.rule:
**规则**：主谓一致 = 主语和谓语的单复数对齐（谓语 = 动词 + TAM 的整体）。**语法一致（默认原则）**：主语的语法形式定谓语——`The parents are cooking.`（复数）、`The soup is ready.`（单数 / 不可数）。**意义一致**：集体名词看「整体还是成员」——family / team / crowd 看作整体用单数（`The family is big.`），强调成员各自的动作用复数（`The family are having dinner.`）；people / police 这类本身就表复数概念，谓语一律用复数（`The police are coming.`）。**each / every / 不定代词**（someone / everyone / nobody / something …）作主语一律配单数谓语：`Every member has …`、`Each of the neighbors is …`。检验顺序：先划掉 of 介词短语抓主语核心，再问「整体还是成员」。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `The parents are cooking. / The soup is ready.` —— 语法一致：主语的单复数形式定谓语
✅ `The family is big.（整体）/ The family are having dinner.（成员）` —— 意义一致：整体单数、成员复数
❌ `Everyone are happy. / Each of the neighbors are here.` —— 不定代词与 each / every 一律配单数谓语

practice.stem: 「The family are all working around the big table.」为什么用复数 are？
options: family 这个词本身就是复数
强调家人们各自在忙，被看作成员
因为句子是现在进行时
practice.explanation: **B**。family 在这里强调家人们各自在忙（成员），谓语用复数 are；看作「一个家庭」整体才用单数。

practice.stem: 「Every member of the family has a job.」的谓语为什么用 has？
options: family 是复数，谓语要配复数
主语核心 every member 一律配单数谓语，of the family 只是修饰
practice.explanation: **C**。every + 名词一律配单数谓语，主语核心是 Every member；of the family 只是修饰，不影响谓语。

practice.template: All the members of the family have a job. → Every member of the family ______ a job.
practice.explanation: **has**。every member 作主语一律配单数谓语，have 变 has。

practice.template: The family members are having dinner now. → The family ______ having dinner now.
practice.explanation: **are**。the family 指「家人们」（成员），谓语用复数 are。

practice.template: The neighbors are each bringing a carrot. → Each of the neighbors ______ bringing a carrot.
practice.explanation: **is**。each of + 复数名词作主语，主语核心是 each，谓语用单数 is。

practice.prompt: 用 family / everyone / each of 各造一句：family 按「成员」用复数谓语，everyone 与 each of 用单数谓语，并各说一句理由。
sample: The family are having dinner together.
Everyone is happy today.

quiz.stem: 「The parents are cooking the soup.」用 are 的依据是什么？
options: 语法一致：主语 The parents 是复数
quiz.explanation: **A**。语法一致（默认原则）：主语 The parents 是复数，谓语用 are。

quiz.stem: 不定代词 someone / everyone / nobody 作主语，谓语一律用______数。
quiz.explanation: **单**。不定代词作主语一律配单数谓语：Someone has …、Everyone is …。

quiz.stem: 哪句的谓语用对了？
options: Everyone are happy about the true story.
Each of the neighbors are here.
The little team is working hard.
quiz.explanation: **C**。team 看作整体用单数 is；A、B 的 everyone / each of 应配单数，D 的 police 应配复数 are。

quiz.stem: 「The family ______ (be) having dinner.」强调家人们各自在吃，谓语用复数。
quiz.explanation: **are**。family 看作成员「家人们各自在吃」，谓语用复数 are（看作整体才用 is）。

quiz.stem: 「Two wooden tables were given to the rabbit.」是什么结构？（复习 U07L53：被动的特殊变形与限制）
options: 双宾被动，物作主语，间接宾语前补 to
quiz.explanation: **A**。物 two wooden tables 提为主语、间接宾语前补 to——双宾被动的物作主语路线（U07L53）。

quiz.stem: 独立主格「名词 + 分词」是______从句的简化。（复习 U06L51：独立主格：名词 + 分词的状语）

title: 主谓一致 II：就近、就远与陷阱表
objective: 今天只学一个点：就近原则、就远原则与陷阱表。就近原则：`either … or` / `neither … nor` / `not only … but also` 和 `there be` 的谓语跟着最近的名词（`There is a carrot and two apples.`）。就远原则：`together with` / `as well as` / `except` / `with` 引出的部分不影响谓语，谓语只看最前面的主语（`The rabbit, as well as the wolves, is hungry.`）。陷阱逐个记：`one of + 复数名词` → 谓语单数（主语核心是 one）；`the number of …` → 单数（一个数量值），`a number of …` → 复数（= many）。检验三步：先抓主语核心 → 再判就近还是就远 → 最后套陷阱表。
goal: 能拿下主谓一致陷阱题（The rabbit family is having dinner.）。

sentences.en: The old story on the big sign is full of false words.
sentences.zh: 大招牌上的旧故事满是假话。

sentences.en: The wolf says he never told a lie.
sentences.zh: 狼说他从来没有撒过谎。

sentences.en: The numbers in the story were exaggerated by someone.
sentences.zh: 故事里的数字被人夸大了。

sentences.en: The rabbit is checking every word on the sign now.
sentences.zh: 兔子正在核对招牌上的每一个字。

sentences.en: Either the rabbit or the wolf is wrong about the number.
sentences.zh: 兔子和狼中有一个把数字搞错了。
sentences.note: 就近原则：either … or 连接两个主语，谓语跟着最近的 the wolf，用单数 is

sentences.en: There is one lie and two false words on the sign.
sentences.zh: 招牌上有一处谎言和两个假字。
sentences.note: 就近原则：there be 的谓语跟着最近的 one lie，用 is——不能看见后面的 words 就用 are

sentences.en: The rabbit, as well as the little sheep, is checking the words.
sentences.zh: 兔子和小绵羊一起在核对字句。
sentences.note: 就远原则：as well as 引出的部分不影响谓语——只看最前面的 The rabbit，用 is

sentences.en: The whole story, except a small part, remains true.
sentences.zh: 整个故事除了一小部分，其余都是真的。

sentences.en: The sign, together with the old note, proves the true story.
sentences.zh: 招牌和那张旧字条一起证明了真实的故事。

sentences.en: One of the neighbors is reading the sign.
sentences.zh: 邻居中的一位正在读招牌。
sentences.note: 陷阱：one of + 复数名词——主语核心是 One，谓语用单数 is

sentences.en: The number of false words is small now, and a number of true stories are on the sign.
sentences.zh: 现在假字的数量很少，真实的故事倒有不少。
sentences.note: 陷阱对：the number of … 是「数量值」，用单数 is；a number of = many，用复数 are

sentences.en: The amount of true news is large, and the whole forest is happy.
sentences.zh: 真实消息的总量很大，整个森林都很开心。

sentences.en: The true story is not the same as the old one, and the dinner can start.
sentences.zh: 真实的故事和旧故事不一样，晚餐可以开始了。

The whole story, except a small part, remains true.

The rabbit is checking every word on the sign now.

notes.rule:
**规则**：主谓一致三大原则的最后一块：**就近**与**就远**。**就近原则**：`either … or` / `neither … nor` / `not only … but also` 和 `there be` 的谓语跟着最近的名词——`There is a carrot and two apples.`（近的是 a carrot）、`Either the rabbit or the wolf is wrong.`。**就远原则**：`together with` / `as well as` / `except` / `with` 引出的部分不影响谓语，谓语只看最前面的主语——`The rabbit, as well as the wolves, is hungry.`。**陷阱逐个记**：`one of + 复数名词` → 谓语单数（主语核心是 one）；`the number of …` → 单数（一个数量值），`a number of …` → 复数（= many）。检验三步：先抓主语核心，再判就近还是就远，最后套陷阱表。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `There is a carrot and two apples. / Either the rabbit or the wolf is wrong.` —— 就近：谓语跟着最近的名词
✅ `The rabbit, as well as the wolves, is hungry.` —— 就远：逗号里的部分不影响谓语
❌ `One of the rabbits are white. / The number of carrots are large.` —— one of 与 the number of 都配单数谓语

practice.stem: 「There is one lie and two false words on the sign.」为什么用 is？
options: 就近原则：谓语跟着最近的 one lie
practice.explanation: **B**。there be 用就近原则，谓语跟着最近的 one lie，用单数 is——不能看见后面的 words 就用 are。

practice.stem: 「The rabbit, as well as the little sheep, is checking the words.」的谓语跟着谁？
options: 最前面的 the rabbit（就远原则）
practice.explanation: **C**。就远原则：as well as 引出的部分不影响谓语，谓语只看最前面的 The rabbit，用 is。

practice.template: The rabbits are right, or the wolf is right. → Either the wolf or the rabbits ______ right.
practice.explanation: **are**。either … or 就近：靠近谓语的是 the rabbits（复数），谓语用 are。

practice.template: The rabbit and the wolves are hungry. → The rabbit, together with the wolves, ______ hungry.
practice.explanation: **is**。就远原则：together with 引出的 the wolves 不影响谓语，跟着最前面的 The rabbit 用 is。

practice.template: There are a lot of carrots. → The number of carrots ______ large.
practice.explanation: **is**。the number of … 表「数量」这个整体值，配单数谓语（a number of 才配复数）。

practice.prompt: 用 either … or / …, together with, … / one of + 复数名词 各造一句，说出谓语为什么这么选。
sample: Either the rabbit or the wolf is wrong.
The rabbit, together with the wolves, is hungry.
One of the rabbits is white.
practice.criteria: 就近、就远、陷阱对号入座即可

quiz.stem: 「One of the rabbits is white.」为什么用 is？
options: 主语核心是 one，one of + 复数名词配单数谓语
quiz.explanation: **B**。one of + 复数名词作主语，主语核心是 one，谓语用单数 is。

quiz.stem: the number of … 配______数谓语；a number of … 配复数谓语。
quiz.explanation: **单**。the number of 是「数量值」配单数谓语；a number of = many 配复数谓语。

quiz.stem: 哪句的谓语用对了？
options: There are a carrot and two apples.
The rabbit, together with the wolves, are hungry.
A number of rabbits are here.
One of the rabbits are white.
quiz.explanation: **C**。a number of = many，配复数 are；A 就近是 a carrot 应用 is，B 就远跟 The rabbit 应用 is，D 的 one of 应用 is。

quiz.stem: 就近原则：there be 和 either … ______ 结构的谓语跟着最近的名词。
quiz.explanation: **or**。either … or 是就近原则的常见触发，谓语跟着最近的那个主语。

quiz.stem: 「The rabbit family is having dinner.」这类句子的谓语单复数看什么？（复习 U07L54：主谓一致 I：语法一致与意义一致）
options: 看 family 被当作整体还是成员
看 dinner 是不是复数
quiz.explanation: **A**。集体名词句的谓语看「整体还是成员」（U07L54）——这正是 family 类句子的判据。

quiz.stem: 被动语态的构成：受事主语 + be + 过去______词。（复习 U07L52：被动语态：be + done 与各时态）
quiz.explanation: **分**。被动 = 受事主语 + be + 过去分词（U07L52）。

title: 强调句：It is … that 与 do 强调
objective: U02L16 见过强调句的 it：`It was the little rabbit that opened the shop first.`，还留了一把检验法——今天正式拆解。强调句就是「语法化的重音」：`It is / was + 被强调部分 + that（指人可用 who）+ 其余`，主语、宾语、状语都能拎到焦点位。检验法照 U02L16 的预告：去掉 It is / was … that，剩下的词按原顺序拼起来仍是完整句子。谓语不能进强调句框架（谓语 = 动词 + 时态、情态那套词形的整体），要强调谓语用 do / does / did + 动词原形。最后辨析长得像的主语从句（it 的用法 U02L15 / L16 铺垫过）。
goal: 能强调句中任意成分，能认出并拆解强调句。

sentences.en: The whole forest talks about the old story of Carrot Home.
sentences.zh: 森林里都在谈论 Carrot Home 的旧故事。

sentences.en: Some say the wolf broke ten windows last winter.
sentences.zh: 有人说，狼去年冬天打碎了十扇窗户。

sentences.en: Some say he took a hundred carrots away in the night.
sentences.zh: 有人说，他夜里拿走了一百根胡萝卜。

sentences.en: The rabbit decides to tell the true story to everyone.
sentences.zh: 兔子决定把真实的故事讲给每个人听。

sentences.en: It was the wolf that broke the window last winter.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天打碎窗户的，正是狼。
sentences.note: 强调句：强调主语 the wolf——去掉 It was … that 后 The wolf broke the window last winter 仍成立，U02L16 的检验法正式用起来

sentences.en: It was only one window that the wolf broke.
sentences.zh: 狼打碎的，只是一扇窗户。
sentences.note: 强调句：强调宾语 only one window——把被夸大的部分钉回原样：不是十扇，只有一扇

sentences.en: It was by accident that the wolf broke the window.
sentences.zh: 狼打碎窗户，是出于意外。
sentences.note: 强调句：强调方式状语——主语、宾语、状语都能强调，谓语除外

sentences.en: The wolf did pay for the repair, and the rabbit did forgive him.
sentences.zh: 狼确实赔了修理的钱，兔子也确实原谅了他。
sentences.note: do 强调：did + 动词原形 pay / forgive——「确实赔了、确实原谅了」，时态由 did 承担

sentences.en: The wolf apologizes to the rabbit in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 狼当着大家的面向兔子道了歉。

sentences.en: The rabbit reads every detail of the old sign to the animals.
sentences.zh: 兔子把旧招牌上的每个细节都读给大家听。

sentences.en: The forest becomes silent when the animals hear the truth.
sentences.zh: 听到真相，森林一下子安静下来。

sentences.en: The little sheep rewrites the wrong numbers on the sign.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊把招牌上写错的数字改写过来。

sentences.en: It is the truth that makes everyone quiet again.
sentences.zh: 让大家重新安静下来的，正是真相。
sentences.note: 强调句：强调主语 the truth——去掉框架 The truth makes everyone quiet again 仍成立；去掉后不成句的（如 It is clear that …）是主语从句，见精讲

sentences.en: Some animals now call the wolf a little hero, but he only smiles.
sentences.zh: 有些动物现在管狼叫小英雄，他只是笑笑。

notes.rule:
**规则**：**强调句**公式：`It is / was + 被强调部分 + that（指人可用 who）+ 句子其余部分`。原句 `The wolf broke the window last winter.` 可以三路强调：`It was the wolf that broke the window last winter.`（主语）、`It was the window that the wolf broke last winter.`（宾语）、`It was last winter that the wolf broke the window.`（状语）。**拆解检验法**（U02L16 预告过）：去掉 `It is / was … that`，剩下的词按原顺序拼起来仍是完整句子 = 强调句。**谓语不能强调**——谓语指动词 + 时态、情态那套词形的整体，它进不了强调句框架，要强调就用 **do / does / did + 动词原形**：`The wolf did pay for the repair.`（时态由 do 承担，动词回原形，只用于肯定句）。**强调句 vs 主语从句**：`It is clear that the wolf is right.` 不是强调句——去掉框架后 `Clear that …` 不成句，it 是形式主语（U02L15 / L16），that 从句才是真正主语；强调句的 that 不充当句子成分，只搭架子（另有一说认为 that/who 在从句中充当主/宾——两说均可解题，以检验法为准）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `It was the wolf that broke the window.` —— 强调主语，去掉 It was … that 后句子仍完整
✅ `The wolf did pay for the repair.` —— do 强调谓语：did + 动词原形，时态由 did 承担
❌ `It was at six o'clock when the shop opened.` —— 想写强调句却用了 when：when 引导的是「到点发生某事」的时间句，检验法过不去；强调时间要写 `It was at six o'clock that the shop opened.`

practice.stem: 下面哪句是强调句（可用去掉框架法验证）？
options: It is clear that the wolf broke the window.
It was the wolf that broke the window.
It seems that the new sign is bright.
It is a pity that the old story is wrong.
practice.explanation: **B**。去掉 It was … that 得 The wolf broke the window，句子仍完整，是强调句；A、C、D 去掉框架后都不成句，是 it 作形式主语的主语从句或虚 it。

practice.stem: 「The wolf did pay for the repair.」里的 did 是什么用法？
options: 过去时的实义动词，「做」的意思
do 强调：did + 动词原形强调谓语，「确实赔了」
疑问句的助动词，放错了位置
practice.explanation: **C**。do 强调：did + 动词原形 pay，「确实赔了」；时态由 did 承担，pay 不再变形。

practice.template: The wolf broke the window last winter. → ______ the wolf ______ broke the window last winter.
practice.explanation: **It was；that**。强调主语：It was + 被强调部分（the wolf）+ that + 其余；句首首字母大写，写 It was。

practice.template: The wolf broke only one window. → It was only one window ______ the wolf broke.
practice.explanation: **that**。强调宾语 only one window：that 把宾语顶到焦点位；去掉框架 The wolf broke only one window 仍成立。

practice.template: The wolf paid for the repair. → The wolf ______ pay for the repair.
practice.explanation: **did**。强调谓语用 do / does / did + 动词原形：paid 是过去时，借 did 强调，pay 回原形。

practice.prompt: 用「It was … that」分别强调主语、宾语、状语，改写 The wolf broke the window last winter.（三句），再用 do 强调写一句「狼确实赔了」。
sample: It was the wolf that broke the window last winter.
It was the window that the wolf broke last winter.
It was last winter that the wolf broke the window.
The wolf did pay for the repair.
practice.criteria: 去掉框架后句子还原正确即可

quiz.stem: 哪句是强调句？
options: It is obvious that the wolf helped the shop.
It was by accident that the wolf broke the window.
It is raining outside Carrot Home.
It is five kilometers to the forest.
quiz.explanation: **B**。去掉 It was … that 后 By accident the wolf broke the window 成立，是强调句；A 是主语从句，C 是虚 it（天气），D 是虚 it（距离）。

quiz.stem: 强调句公式：It is / was + 被强调部分 + ______ + 其余。
quiz.explanation: **that（或 who）**。强调句架子：It is / was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余；指人时 that 可换 who。

quiz.stem: 下面哪句的「强调谓语」写对了？
options: The wolf did paid for the repair.
The wolf does paid for the repair.
The wolf did pay for the repair.
The wolf is pay for the repair.
quiz.explanation: **C**。do 强调 = do / does / did + 动词原形：A 的 paid、B 的 paid 都没回原形，D 不是 do 强调句式。

quiz.stem: 谓语要强调用 do / does / did + 动词 ______，不用强调句框架。
quiz.explanation: **原形**。did 已带时态，后面的动词必须回原形：did pay，不写 did paid。

quiz.stem:
Neither the wolf nor the rabbits ______ here.（复习 U07L55：主谓一致 II 就近原则）
- A. is
- B. are
- C. was
- D. be
quiz.explanation: **B**。either … or / neither … nor 谓语就近一致：靠近谓语的 the rabbits 是复数，用 are（U07L55）。

quiz.stem: The accident ______ yesterday.（复习 U07L53：happen 这类动词没有被动形式）
quiz.explanation: **happened**。happen 是不及物动词、没有被动形式：The accident happened，不写 was happened（U07L53）。

title: 倒装：部分倒装与全部倒装
objective: 英语默认语序是「主 + 谓」，为了强调、衔接或修辞，有时把谓语的全部或一部分提到主语前面——这就是倒装。两类分清：全部倒装是谓语（动词 + 时态、情态那套词形的整体）整体前置（`Here comes the wolf.`），部分倒装只是助动词 / 情态动词 / be 提到主语前，同疑问句语序（`Never have I seen it.`）。今天背两组触发：全部倒装三类（方位副词开头 / 地点短语开头 / 表语前置）、部分倒装五大触发（否定词开头 / only + 状语 / 也（不）/ so 提前 / 虚拟省略 if），再用判别三步法还原成正常语序。
goal: 能识别倒装句并还原成正常语序，能造 Never have I … 句。

sentences.en: On a cold morning the animals gather in front of the little shop.
sentences.zh: 一个寒冷的清晨，动物们聚在小店门前。

sentences.en: In front of the shop stands the big sign.
sentences.zh: 店门前立着那块大招牌。
sentences.note: 全部倒装：地点介词短语开头 + 不及物动词 + 主语——先给画面再出主语，叙事常用；还原 The big sign stands in front of the shop

sentences.en: On the wall hangs a picture of the wolf and the rabbit.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着一幅狼和兔子的画。

sentences.en: Among them sits the little sheep, and she holds the old note.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊坐在他们中间，手里拿着那张旧字条。
sentences.note: 全部倒装 · 地点短语前置倒装：Among them sits + 主语——主语是代词时常不倒装，如 Here you are

sentences.en: Seldom does the forest gather like this.
sentences.zh: 森林很少这样聚在一起。

sentences.en: Never have the animals heard such a story.
sentences.zh: 动物们从没听过这样的故事。
sentences.note: 部分倒装：never 否定词开头，助动词 have 提到主语前——还原 The animals have never heard such a story

sentences.en: Only then does the whole forest understand the truth.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，整个森林才明白真相。

sentences.en: So amazing is the story that nobody wants to leave.
sentences.zh: 这个故事如此动人，谁也不想离开。
sentences.note: so…that 的 so 提前：So + 形容词 + be + 主语 + that——书面语的强调节奏；还原 The story is so amazing that …

sentences.en: The rabbit loves the truth, and so does the little sheep.
sentences.zh: 兔子爱真相，小绵羊也是。

sentences.en: Had the rabbit not kept the note, the truth would never have come out.
sentences.zh: 要是兔子没留下那张字条，真相就永远不会揭晓。
sentences.note: 部分倒装 · 虚拟省略 if：Had 提前 = If the rabbit had not kept the note——虚拟语气正式课见 U08L64

sentences.en: The wolf walks to the big sign and thanks everyone in a whisper.
sentences.zh: 狼走到大招牌前，低声向大家道谢。

sentences.en: The animals sit around him and listen quietly.
sentences.zh: 动物们围坐在他身边，静静地听着。

sentences.en: The story touches everyone, and even the wolf smiles.
sentences.zh: 这个故事打动了每个人，连狼都笑了。

vocab.example: On a cold morning the animals gather in front of the little shop.
In front of the shop stands the big sign.
Among them sits the little sheep, and she holds the old note.
Among them sits the little sheep, and she holds the old note.
Seldom does the forest gather like this.
So amazing is the story that nobody wants to leave.
The wolf walks to the big sign and thanks everyone in a whisper.
The story touches everyone, and even the wolf smiles.
The story touches everyone, and even the wolf smiles.
Never have the animals heard such a story.
Only then does the whole forest understand the truth.

notes.rule:
**规则**：倒装就是把**谓语**（动词 + 时态、情态那套词形的整体）的全部或一部分提到主语前。**全部倒装三类触发**：①方位副词开头（`Here comes the wolf.` / `Out ran the rabbit.`）；②地点介词短语开头（`In the forest lived a wolf.`）；③表语前置（`Among them was the rabbit.`）——注意两条纪律：动词单复数跟**真主语**（`Here come the rabbits.` 不写 Here comes the rabbits），主语是代词时常不倒装（`Here you are.`）。**部分倒装五大触发**：否定 / 半否定词开头（never / seldom / hardly / little / not only）、only + 状语开头（only 修饰主语不倒）、so / neither / nor 表「也（不）」、so … that 的 so 提前、虚拟条件句省略 if（had / were / should 提前，正式课见 U08L64）——共同形态是**助动词 / 情态动词 / be 提到主语前**，同疑问句语序。**判别三步法**：①找主语（在谓语前还是后）→ ②看谓语形态（整体提前 = 全部倒装；助情提前 = 部分倒装）→ ③查触发物（句首有没有否定词 / only + 状语 / so / 地点成分）。还要防两个陷阱：否定词在句中不倒装（`I have never seen` 不倒），so 表「也」才倒装（`So does the wolf`），表「确实如此」不倒（`So the wolf does`）。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `Never have the animals heard such a story.` —— never 开头，部分倒装，还原 The animals have never heard such a story
✅ `In front of the shop stands the big sign.` —— 地点短语开头全部倒装，动词 stands 跟真主语 sign（单数）
❌ `Here are you.` —— 主语是代词常不倒装，应写 Here you are

options: Seldom does the wolf come to the village.
Only the rabbit knows the truth.
practice.explanation: **B**。seldom 半否定词开头，助动词 does 提到主语前，是部分倒装；A 是谓语整体前置的全部倒装，C 的 only 修饰主语不倒装，D 主语是代词不倒装。

practice.stem: 「In front of the shop stands the big sign.」的动词为什么用 stands？
options: 跟最靠近的 shop 保持一致
地点状语决定动词形式
跟真主语 the big sign（单数）一致，倒装不动摇主谓一致
倒装句不用管主谓一致
practice.explanation: **C**。全部倒装动词单复数跟真主语：真主语是 the big sign（单数），用 stands，跟最靠近的 shop 无关。

practice.template: The animals have never heard such a story. → Never ______ the animals heard such a story.
practice.explanation: **have**。never 否定词开头触发部分倒装：助动词 have 提到主语前，还原 The animals have never heard …。

practice.template: The whole forest understood the truth only then. → Only then ______ the whole forest understand the truth.
practice.explanation: **did**。only + 状语（only then）开头触发部分倒装：一般过去借 did 提前，实义动词回原形 understand。

practice.template: The big sign stands in front of the shop. → In front of the shop ______ the big sign.
practice.explanation: **stands**。地点短语开头 + 不及物动词 + 主语 = 全部倒装；动词 stands 跟真主语 the big sign 一致。

practice.prompt: 先用「Never + 助动词 + 主语」造一句（Never have I … 句式），再把 The animals gathered in front of the shop 改成地点状语开头的全部倒装，把 The whole forest understood the truth only then 改成部分倒装。
sample: Never have the animals heard such a story.
In front of the shop gathered the animals.
Only then did the whole forest understand the truth.
practice.criteria: 还原后语序正确、主谓一致不破即可

quiz.stem: 哪句使用了部分倒装？
options: On the wall hangs a picture.
Never have the animals heard such a story.
quiz.explanation: **B**。never 开头，have 提到主语前，是部分倒装；A、C、D 都是谓语整体前置的全部倒装。

quiz.stem: 「Never have the animals heard it.」还原成正常语序：The animals ______ heard it.
quiz.explanation: **have never**。还原正常语序：主语 + 助动词 + never + 过去分词，never 不再放开头。

quiz.stem: 「Here comes the wolf.」属于什么？
options: 全部倒装：谓语整体前置，方位副词 here 开头
quiz.explanation: **C**。here 方位副词开头 + 不及物动词 comes + 主语 = 全部倒装。

quiz.stem: 部分倒装的形态：把 ______ / 情态动词 / be 提到主语前，同疑问句语序。
quiz.explanation: **助动词**。部分倒装只提前助动词 / 情态动词 / be，剩余部分留在主语后，语序同疑问句。

quiz.stem: 「It was in the forest that the rabbit ate the carrot.」被强调的部分是？（复习 U07L56：强调句）
quiz.explanation: **C**。被强调部分是 in the forest 这个地点状语；去掉 It was … that 后句子仍成立（U07L56）。

quiz.stem: The rabbit family ______ a big one.（复习 U07L54：意义一致）
quiz.explanation: **is**。a big one 把 the rabbit family 看作「一个家庭」整体，谓语用单数 is（U07L54 意义一致：整体单数；强调成员各自动作才用复数，如 U07L54 P2）。

title: 省略与还原：四个公式
objective: 英语讨厌重复：上文刚说过的成分，下文再出现就省掉。省略让句子简洁，也让人「看不见主语、看不见谓语」——读长句卡壳，多半是不知道省掉了什么。总原则只有一条：省掉的成分，语境里能明确补回来；补不回来的不能省。今天背四个还原公式：①并列句还原（找连词，缺什么补什么）；②状语从句还原（when / if / though + 形容词 → 补主语 + be）；③不定式还原（句尾的 to 是钩子，必须保留）；④so / not 还原（`I think so` / `I hope not` 顶替整个从句）。
goal: 能读懂省略句并补全被省的成分。

sentences.en: The wolf tells his story in a few brief words.
sentences.zh: 狼用几句简短的话讲了自己的故事。

sentences.en: The little sheep asks if the shop will keep growing.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊问小店会不会继续做下去。

sentences.en: "I think so," answers the rabbit.
sentences.zh: 「我想会的，」兔子回答。
sentences.note: so 替代整个从句：I think so = I think that the shop will keep growing——上文说过的从句用 so 顶替，不重复

sentences.en: The wolf says he hopes to stay in the forest, and everyone agrees.
sentences.zh: 狼说他想留在森林里，大家都同意。

sentences.en: Nobody worries about the old days any more.
sentences.zh: 谁也不再为过去的日子担心。

sentences.en: When young, the wolf knew the forest well.
sentences.zh: 狼年轻时就很熟悉这片森林。
sentences.note: 状语从句省略主语 + be：When young = When the wolf was young——从句主语与主句主语一致才可省

sentences.en: The little sheep helps at the shop if necessary.
sentences.zh: 必要时，小绵羊就来店里帮忙。
sentences.note: 固定省略：if necessary = if it is necessary——固定搭配整体省，见惯就认

sentences.en: The rabbit wants to write a new note, and the wolf wants to.
sentences.zh: 兔子想写一张新字条，狼也想写。
sentences.note: 不定式省略保留 to：wants to = wants to write a new note——to 是省略后看得见的钩子

sentences.en: "Will the cold winter come soon?" the mouse asks.
sentences.zh: 「冷冬天很快就来吗？」老鼠问。

sentences.en: "I hope not," says the wolf.
sentences.zh: 「希望不会，」狼说。
sentences.note: not 替代否定从句：I hope not = I hope that the cold winter will not come soon——否定替代不能写 I don't hope so

sentences.en: The old wolf is not afraid of the truth.
sentences.zh: 老狼并不害怕真相。

sentences.en: Nobody doubts the wolf now, and he expects no gifts.
sentences.zh: 如今谁也不怀疑狼，他也不指望什么礼物。

sentences.en: The animals nod to him one by one.
sentences.zh: 动物们一个接一个地向他点头。

sentences.en: The little sheep adds a word, and the wolf replies with a brief smile.
sentences.zh: 小绵羊补了一句，狼用一个简短的微笑作答。

sentences.en: Everyone supposes the shop will be safe from now on.
sentences.zh: 大家都觉得，小店从此就安稳了。

vocab.example: The wolf tells his story in a few brief words.
The wolf says he hopes to stay in the forest, and everyone agrees.
The old wolf is not afraid of the truth.
Nobody doubts the wolf now, and he expects no gifts.
Nobody doubts the wolf now, and he expects no gifts.
The animals nod to him one by one.
The little sheep adds a word, and the wolf replies with a brief smile.
The little sheep adds a word, and the wolf replies with a brief smile.
Everyone supposes the shop will be safe from now on.
"I hope not," says the wolf.
"I think so," answers the rabbit.

notes.rule:
**规则**：省略 = 省掉语境能补回的重复件。**四个还原公式**：①**并列句还原**：找并列连词（and / but / or），看两侧缺什么补什么——左边有主谓、右边只有主语和宾语，就补回重复的谓语（`The wolf ate a carrot and the little sheep an apple.` 补回 ate）；②**状语从句还原**：从句只剩「when / if / though + 形容词 / 分词」时补 `主语 + be`，且**从句主语必须与主句一致**（`When young, the wolf knew the forest well.` = When the wolf was young …）；固定省略照单全收（`if necessary` = if it is necessary）；③**不定式还原**：句尾孤零零一个 `to`，补回 `to + 动词`——**to 必须保留**，它是省略后看得见的钩子（`The wolf wants to.` = wants to write a new note）；④**so / not 还原**：`I think so` = I think that …，`I hope not` = I hope that … not——so 顶肯定从句、not 顶否定从句，hope / be afraid 两边都能接（`I hope so` / `I hope not`），否定不写 I don't hope so。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `When young, the wolf knew the forest well.` —— 还原 When the wolf was young，从句主语与主句一致才能省
✅ `The rabbit wants to write a note, and the wolf wants to.` —— 保留 to，补回 to write a note
❌ `When hungry, the carrot looked delicious.` —— carrot 不会 hungry，主语不一致不能省，要补出 When the wolf was hungry

practice.stem: 「Will the wolf leave? — I hope not.」里的 not 顶替什么？
options: 整个否定从句：I hope that the wolf will not leave
practice.explanation: **B**。not 顶替整个否定从句：I hope not = I hope that the wolf will not leave；so 顶替肯定从句，不能用 I don't hope so。

practice.stem: 「When young, the wolf knew the forest well.」还原后是哪句？
options: When the wolf was young, the wolf knew the forest well.
When young was the wolf, the wolf knew the forest well.
When the wolf young, the wolf knew the forest well.
When the forest was young, the wolf knew it well.
practice.explanation: **A**。状语从句省略「主语 + be」：When young = When the wolf was young，且从句主语与主句主语 the wolf 一致。

practice.template: When young, the wolf knew the forest well. = When ______ young, the wolf knew the forest well.
practice.explanation: **the wolf was**。状语从句还原公式：when + 形容词 = when + 主语 + be；主语取主句主语 the wolf。

practice.template: The rabbit can eat the carrot if he wants to. = if he wants to ______ the carrot.
practice.explanation: **eat**。不定式省略只省动词及其宾语，保留 to 这个钩子：if he wants to = if he wants to eat the carrot。

practice.template: The wolf ate a carrot and the little sheep an apple. = and the little sheep ______ an apple.
practice.explanation: **ate**。并列句还原：and 后省掉了与前句相同的谓语 ate，补回即 and the little sheep ate an apple。

practice.prompt: 用 I think so 与 I hope not 各写一组问答（各 2 句），再写 1 个「when / if + 形容词」的省略句，并写出它的还原式。
sample: Will the shop keep growing? I think so.
Will the wolf leave? I hope not.
When young, the wolf knew the forest well.（还原：When the wolf was young, the wolf knew the forest well.）
practice.criteria: 还原：When the wolf was young, the wolf knew the forest well.

quiz.stem: 下面哪句是「so / not 替代」的正确用法？
quiz.explanation: **B**。肯 so 否 not：I hope not = I hope that … not；否定替代不写 I don't hope so，也不把 not 直接塞进 that 从句外。

quiz.stem: 状语从句的省略省掉的是「主语 + ______」，且从句主语须与主句主语一致。
quiz.explanation: **be**。状语从句省略省掉「主语 + be」（When young = When the wolf was young），主语不一致就不能省。

quiz.stem: 不定式省略的规范写法是哪个？
quiz.explanation: **B**。不定式省略必须保留 to：if you want to = if you want to eat the carrot。

quiz.stem: 「恐怕不会」= I'm afraid ______.
quiz.explanation: **not**。be afraid 的否定替代用 not：I'm afraid not = I'm afraid that it will not happen；肯定才用 so。

quiz.stem: 「Never have the animals heard it.」是哪种倒装？（复习 U07L57：倒装）
quiz.explanation: **B**。never 开头、助动词 have 提到主语前，只提前助动词 = 部分倒装（U07L57）。

quiz.stem: The number of the animals ______ growing.（复习 U07L55：the number of … 谓语用单数）
quiz.explanation: **is**。the number of …（……的数量）作主语，谓语用单数 is growing（U07L55）。

title: 连词收口：并列、从属与「不同时现」
objective: 连词是句子的连接件：长句 = 简单句的并列或嵌套。今天把连接件收口成三类：并列连词（fanboys 七兄弟 for / and / nor / but / or / yet / so，各标一种逻辑关系）、从属连词（because / although / when / if 引导从句，让分句挂到主句上）、关联连词（both … and / not only … but also / either … or / neither … nor / not … but 成对使用、两边平行）。最后收两组「不同时现」铁律——`although × but`、`because × so`：这是中文「虽然…但是…」「因为…所以…」直译的第一大病句，一句话只能留一个连接件。
goal: 能把句子接得顺、接得对，写作中连词零病句。

sentences.en: The wolf stays at the shop, and the little sheep brings the best carrots.
sentences.zh: 狼留在店里，小绵羊带来最好的胡萝卜。
sentences.note: 并列连词 and：顺承关系——fanboys 七兄弟 for / and / nor / but / or / yet / so 各标一种逻辑

sentences.en: The forest was quiet before, but today every animal comes.
sentences.zh: 森林从前很安静，可今天每只动物都来了。

sentences.en: Hurry, or the soup will get cold.
sentences.zh: 快点，不然汤就凉了。

sentences.en: Nobody leaves early, for the day is too good to miss.
sentences.zh: 谁也不愿早走，因为这样的好日子不容错过。

sentences.en: Both the wolf and the little sheep work at the shop.
sentences.zh: 狼和小绵羊都在店里干活。
sentences.note: 关联连词 both … and：成对使用，两边结构平行——词对词、句对句

sentences.en: The rabbit is not only a good cook but also a good friend.
sentences.zh: 兔子不光是个好厨师，还是个好朋友。

sentences.en: Either the wolf tells the story or the little sheep does.
sentences.zh: 要么狼来讲这个故事，要么小绵羊讲。
sentences.note: either … or：成对使用——谓语就近一致细则在 U07L55 收口

sentences.en: Neither the wolf nor the rabbit wants any gift.
sentences.zh: 狼和兔子都不想要什么礼物。

sentences.en: Although the day is long, nobody feels tired.
sentences.zh: 虽然这一天很长，谁也不觉得累。
sentences.note: 不同时现铁律其一：although 从属连词一出现，同句的 but 必须删——「虽然…但是…」只留一个

sentences.en: Because everyone knows the truth, the forest feels light.
sentences.zh: 因为人人都知道了真相，森林都轻快起来。
sentences.note: 铁律其二：because 不配 so——「因为…所以…」只留一个连接件，要 so 就删 because

sentences.en: The wolf tells the truth about the old days, and everyone believes him.
sentences.zh: 狼讲了过去那些日子的真相，大家都相信他。

sentences.en: The animals greet the wolf with loud cheers and joy.
sentences.zh: 动物们用热烈的欢呼迎接狼。

sentences.en: Now everyone trusts the wolf and the little shop.
sentences.zh: 如今人人都信任狼和这家小店。

sentences.en: The animals honor the wolf as a proud partner of Carrot Home.
sentences.zh: 动物们把狼敬为 Carrot Home 骄傲的合伙人。

sentences.en: The big dinner starts, and Carrot Home will certainly stay open forever.
sentences.zh: 大餐开始了，Carrot Home 一定会永远开下去。

notes.rule:
**规则**：连词三类各管一摊。**并列连词** = fanboys 七兄弟 **for / and / nor / but / or / yet / so**：and 顺承、but / yet 转折、or 选择或「否则」、so 结果、for 原因（书面）、nor「也不」（后面倒装）——连接地位平等的词、短语或分句。**从属连词**（because / although / when / if / while）引导从句，让分句降级挂在主句上。**关联连词**成对使用（both … and / not only … but also / either … or / neither … nor / not … but），两边结构必须平行（词对词、句对句），either … or / neither … nor 的谓语**就近一致**（细则在 U07L55 收口）。**两组「不同时现」铁律**（本课收口）：①`Although the wolf ran fast, the rabbit escaped.` ✅ / `Although …, but …` ❌；②`Because the carrot was gone, the rabbit cried.` ✅ / `Because …, so …` ❌。原因：although / because 是从属连词，but / so 是并列连词，一句话只能有一个连接件撑骨架——写完自查：见 although / because，就删同句的 but / so。
例句（✅ 正确 / ❌ 错误对照）：
examples: ✅ `Although the day is long, nobody feels tired.` —— 只留 although，中文习惯里的「但是」被吞掉
✅ `Everyone knows the truth, so the forest feels light.` —— 只留 so 表结果
❌ `Because everyone knows the truth, so the forest feels light.` —— because × so 同现，删掉一个（留 because 或留 so 都行）

practice.stem: 下面哪句是「不同时现」病句？
options: Although the day is long, nobody feels tired.
The day is long, but nobody feels tired.
Because everyone knows the truth, so the forest feels light.
The forest feels light, for everyone knows the truth.
practice.explanation: **C**。because（从属连词）与 so（并列连词）同现是「不同时现」病句；A 只留 although、B 只留 but、D 用 for 表原因，都只用了一个连接件。

practice.stem: 「The rabbit is not only a good cook but also a good friend.」为什么对？
options: not only … but also 成对使用，两边结构平行（表语对表语）
not only … but also 只能连接单词
practice.explanation: **C**。关联连词必须成对使用（not only … but also），且两边结构平行：good cook 对 good friend（表语对表语）。

practice.template: The day is long, ______ nobody feels tired.
practice.explanation: **but（或 yet）**。前后是转折关系，but / yet 两个并列连词都标转折，写哪个都对；注意全句只有这一个连接件，不再加 although。

practice.template: Everyone knows the truth, ______ the forest feels light.
practice.explanation: **so**。前因后果，用 so 表结果；前面不再加 Because。

practice.template: ______ the wolf ______ the little sheep work at the shop.
practice.explanation: **Both；and**。两者都：both … and 成对使用，两边结构平行（the wolf 对 the little sheep）。

practice.prompt: 用 but、so、for 各连接一组句子写 3 句，再用 both … and 与 not only … but also 各造一句写 2 句，写完自查两组「不同时现」。
sample: The day is long, but nobody feels tired.
Everyone knows the truth, so the forest feels light.
The wolf stays, for the shop needs him.
Both the wolf and the little sheep work at the shop.
The rabbit is not only a good cook but also a good friend.
practice.criteria: 连词对、成对使用、无「不同时现」病句即可

practice.prompt: 仿写句群：用本单元学的 2~3 个句型（被动 be + done、强调句 It is … that、倒装 Never have … 任选）写一个 3 句以上的句群，写真相大白后 Carrot Home 庆祝的一幕；句与句之间用连接词（and / but / so / then）或指代（it / him / they）衔接，写完自查「不同时现」（无 although × but、because × so），不写孤立造句。
sample: The whole story was written down by the rabbit in a short note.
It was the wolf that saved the father's box years ago.
Now everyone trusts him, and the shop is filled with friends.
Never have the animals celebrated such a bright day at Carrot Home.
practice.criteria: 句型对、句数达标、有衔接手段，三档自判即可

quiz.stem: 哪句写对了？
options: Although the wolf was hungry, but it didn't eat the carrot.
The wolf was hungry, but it didn't eat the carrot.
Because the wolf was hungry, so it ate the carrot.
Although the wolf was hungry, so it didn't eat the carrot.
quiz.explanation: **B**。一句话只留一个连接件：A 的 although × but、C 的 because × so、D 的 although × so 都是「不同时现」病句。

quiz.stem: fanboys 七兄弟：for, and, nor, but, or, yet, ______.
quiz.explanation: **so**。fanboys = for / and / nor / but / or / yet / so 七兄弟，so 表结果。

quiz.stem: 哪句的关联连词用对了？
options: Both the wolf and the little sheep works at the shop.
The wolf both the little sheep work at the shop.
Both the wolf and the little sheep work at the shop.
Both the wolf but the little sheep work at the shop.
quiz.explanation: **C**。both … and 成对使用、两边平行，both…and 连接并列主语用复数（狼和小绵羊两者），谓语用 work；A 的 works 误用单数，B、D 拆开或换错连词。

quiz.stem: 「虽然…但是…」英语只留一个：although 不配 ______.
quiz.explanation: **but**。铁律其一：although 不配 but——「虽然…但是…」只留 although，或只留 but。

quiz.stem: 「I hope not」的 not 顶替的是整个？（复习 U07L58：省略与还原）
quiz.explanation: **B**。so / not 替代整个从句：I hope not = I hope that the wolf will not leave（U07L58）。

quiz.stem: 「It was the wolf that gave the recipe.」是 ______ 句，去掉 It was … that 后句子仍成立。（复习 U07L56：强调句）
quiz.explanation: **强调**。It was … that 去掉后 The wolf gave the recipe 仍成立，是强调句（U07L56）。
